[RTIM.14.1] **Purpose.** The runtime executes a compiled `.dstest` — the `Test*`
scenario and `Oracle*` oracle atoms ([RDSC.7.1]) — with a test-mode interpreter that
is a harness on this document's terms ([RTIM.2], [RTIM.3], [RTIM.5], [RTIM.6]):
an ordinary engine on the mock clock, driven by assertion and pumping, observed
through the stream. The interpreter adds no evaluation machinery of its own.
Its surface contract is `LTSL`; its lowering is [RLOW.17].
